items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: This is my Uncle Roscoe, yeah.

ctx.x: Now, I was going to ask you about dates now. Where were you when the big storm was? Were you in the city? Are we out of there?

No, that big storm, I remember my grandfather was living. And I don't know whether he was here, but he had came to New Orleans after the storm. And he had... You know, my grandfather never did like New Orleans. I don't know why. And he had went down to the... I remember he was describing to the other sisters and brothers about how the French market was all... The top and thing was all tore down and everything. And my Aunt Bella was living here then, I'm sure, yeah. And he had another son. This is my Uncle Roscoe,…
Just getting back to the city. Yeah.
